title: Organize JSON schema output by protocol category
body:
With 325+ schemas in a flat directory, navigation was becoming unwieldy. JSON schema generation now mirrors the source protocol structure.

## Changes

- **Build script** (`scripts/build-schemas.ts`): Generates schemas into category subdirectories matching namespace organization
- **Directory structure**: `json-schema/{data,ui,system,ai,api}/` instead of flat 325-file directory
- **Documentation**: Added `json-schema/README.md` with category breakdown and usage patterns

## Schema Distribution

```
data/    74 schemas  (Business Logic & Data Modeling)
ui/      39 schemas  (Presentation & Interaction)
system/ 112 schemas  (Runtime Configuration & Security)
ai/      86 schemas  (AI/ML Capabilities)
api/     12 schemas  (API Contracts & Envelopes)
```

The `package.json` files array already includes `json-schema/`, so subdirectories are automatically included in published packages.
